paymentAccountingInvariant: payment.amount == SUM(SellerOrder merchandise allocations) + SUM(StoreShipping|StoreShippingGroup allocations), once. Group allocations carry the customer-facing charge bucket keyed by ShippingGroupId; they are neither seller revenue, commission, nor carrier cost. ResolveShippingAllocationRows refuses payment.shipping_group.sum_mismatch when SUM(group amounts) != payable.ShippingAmount, payment.shipping_group.duplicate on repeated identity, payment.shipping_group.identity_required on Guid.Empty, payment.shipping_group.amount_positive on non-positive amounts — all before any payment/allocation row is written.
